title: GODMAN-LAUNCH — /godman-npm-check: live npm registry publish status
description: New /godman-npm-check command that queries npm registry live for each of the 7 Godman protocols + SDK. Shows ✅/❌ per package with published version, or 'NOT PUBLISHED' if pending. Summary: X/8 published. Essential for tracking launch day progress. Also shows npm login status.
